basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast based in Seattle, Washington, working as a freelance graphic designer. I have a passion for exploring new software and digital tools, especially in video editing and animation. I enjoy cooking and experimenting with recipes, particularly focusing on healthy eating. My typical online hours are late evenings, after my work and family commitments. I'm in a long-term relationship, and we often collaborate on DIY projects around the house.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have spent the last five years working in digital media. My expertise is largely self-taught, driven by a curiosity to stay updated with the latest technology trends and tools. I frequently participate in online courses and webinars to enhance my skills.
